title.zh: 风洞自动化试验：三维虚拟流程
title.en: Automated wind-tunnel testing: a virtual 3D workflow

source.zh: 几何参照：美国佛罗里达大学 NHERI 边界层风洞的公开文献（Catarelli 等 2020；Shields 等 2023；Whiteman 等 2018、2022；Mokhtar 等 2024）；机械臂网格：ROS-Industrial universal_robot（BSD-3-Clause）；场景由本实验室 L30.1 制作；三维引擎 three.js（MIT）。
source.en: Geometry follows published literature on the University of Florida NHERI Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel (Catarelli et al. 2020; Shields et al. 2023; Whiteman et al. 2018, 2022; Mokhtar et al. 2024); robot-arm meshes from ROS-Industrial universal_robot (BSD-3-Clause); scene built by this lab (L30.1); 3D engine three.js (MIT).

time.zh: 示意：非实测、非实时；机械臂换模工作站为虚拟设计、未建造；场景版本 2026-11-14。
time.en: Illustrative: not measured, not live; the robotic model-exchange workstation is a virtual design, not built; scene version 2026-11-14.

use.zh: 探索性科研展示，未经同行评审；不代表该设施的实际系统、计划或认可，不作运行、安全或设计依据。
use.en: Exploratory research display, not peer reviewed; it does not represent the facility's actual systems, plans or endorsement, and is not for operation, safety or design.
